quotes.text: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
quotes.for: Launch announcement and target workflows.

quotes.text: The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached input tokens, a 95% discount) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.
quotes.for: API token pricing, cached discount, and context window.

quotes.text: While Carbon tackles your hardest, long-horizon projects and Hydrogen handles fast everyday execution, Neon balances depth and efficiency.
quotes.for: Positioning between Carbon and Hydrogen.

quotes.text: On SWE-sweep, it already leads on the mini-SWE harness (12.8%) and more than triples to a state-of-the-art 39.0% in Google Antigravity showing what the Antigravity harness unlocks.
quotes.for: SWE-sweep score in Google Antigravity.

quotes.text: We found that with real-time safeguards at its highest thinking level, Neon resisted every attack within this Gray Swan benchmark
quotes.for: Gray Swan indirect prompt injection result.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Neon for cyber is rolling out to trusted defenders in the coming days as part of the Fairwind Program
quotes.for: Cyber version via the Fairwind Program.

quotes.text: ranking #1 overall on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index (58.6), with a score of 65.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.1
quotes.for: Coding Agent Index and Terminal-Bench scores.

quotes.text: To request access to the Fairwind Program, contact your Cloud account team.
quotes.for: Access request procedure for Fairwind.

title: Google continues to accelerate its release cadence with Gemini 4 Neon

quotes.text: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in just seven weeks.
quotes.for: Release cadence of Gemini 4 models.

quotes.text: Neon (xhigh) scores 61 on the Intelligence Index, 1 point ahead of Carbon (high), with small improvements in agentic knowledge work, visual reasoning and coding.
quotes.for: Intelligence Index score of 61 and comparison to Carbon.

quotes.text: It costs $6.44 per task, ~17% less than Carbon ($7.76 at non-discounted pricing), and takes ~21 minutes per task, ~40% less than Carbon (~36 minutes).
quotes.for: Cost and time per task compared with Carbon.

quotes.text: Neon uses ~15% more output tokens per task, so the lower cost comes purely from its 25% lower token prices
quotes.for: Output token use versus Carbon.

quotes.text: With Antigravity CLI, Neon (xhigh) scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, 3 points ahead of Carbon (high, 55).
quotes.for: Independent Coding Agent Index score.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Neon in Antigravity has an average Cost per Task of $6.86, compared to $12.61 for Claude Opus 5.5 (max) and $15.47 for Claude Fable 5.2 (xhigh).
quotes.for: Coding agent cost per task comparison.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Neon offers four effort levels (low, medium, high, and xhigh)
quotes.for: Four configurable effort levels.

quotes.text: $3/$15 per 1M input/output tokens, 50% above Gemini 4 Carbon’s currently discounted price of $2/$10 (which ends on November 30), and 25% below its standard $4/$20.
quotes.for: Pricing comparison with standard and promotional Carbon rates.

quotes.text: and the lower time from its higher output speed (~110 vs ~57 output tokens per second)
quotes.for: Output speed of 110 tokens per second.

quotes.text: Neon (xhigh) scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, 1 point ahead of Gemini 4 Carbon (high) and 3rd overall, behind GPT-6.2 Astra (max) and Claude Fable 5.2 (max)
quotes.for: Intelligence Index ranking third overall behind Astra and Fable.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Neon is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.
quotes.for: General availability in GitHub Copilot.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Neon is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users.
quotes.for: Eligible Copilot plans.

quotes.text: This model is billed at provider list pricing under usage-based billing.
quotes.for: Usage-based billing terms in Copilot.

quotes.text: You can select the model in the model picker in: Visual Studio Code Visual Studio Copilot CLI GitHub Copilot coding agent GitHub Copilot app github.com GitHub Mobile on iOS and Android JetBrains IDEs Xcode Eclipse
quotes.for: Supported IDEs and environments in GitHub Copilot.

title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, touting lower costs for complex AI coding tasks

quotes.text: The near-term opportunity lies in supervised autonomy, with AI agents handling increasingly complex tasks while developers retain oversight and accountability
quotes.for: Analyst view on supervised autonomy for coding agents.

quotes.text: Autonomous AI agents may not yet be ready to independently manage production software development, with reliability and the complexity of enterprise codebases remaining significant obstacles
quotes.for: Enterprise obstacles for autonomous coding agents.

title: Gemini 4 Neon replaces Argon for Google AI Pro subscribers

quotes.text: In Google AI Pro, the new model replaces Argon and the older Pro model, while Carbon stays exclusive to AI Ultra.
quotes.for: Replacement of Argon in Google AI Pro.

quotes.text: Google AI Pro costs $19.99 a month in the US and €21.99 in Germany.
quotes.for: Google AI Pro subscription price.

quotes.text: Carbon, Google's most capable model, remains limited to AI Ultra, which starts at $99.99 a month.
quotes.for: AI Ultra price and Carbon exclusivity.

quotes.text: Neon is not part of the free tier or Google AI Plus, which costs $4.99 a month.
quotes.for: No Neon for free and AI Plus users.

quotes.text: Developers also have to pay, since the Gemini API pricing page lists no free tier for Neon
quotes.for: No free API tier for developers.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Neon is adapted from Gemini 4 Carbon.
quotes.for: Model lineage.

quotes.text: The knowledge cutoff for Gemini 4 Neon is March 2026
quotes.for: Knowledge cutoff.

quotes.text: Gemini 4 Neon showed an increase in general capability under our MCC assessment compared with Gemini 4 Argon, however this falls below our MCC threshold
quotes.for: Capability gain below the MCC threshold.

quotes.text: therefore a full suite of critical capability evaluations was not required
quotes.for: No full critical capability evaluation.

quotes.text: We carry forward our capability evaluation results and T/CCL determinations from Gemini 4 Argon
quotes.for: Determinations carried forward from Argon.

quotes.text: The full Safety & Security Report for Gemini 4 Neon will be available in the coming days.
quotes.for: Safety report pending.
